title: Guide local coding via the guided_coding Agentic Recipe
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, loads the `guided_coding` durable graph (controller `story`, store `memory`). He wants Cursor to answer only short engineering direction while a project-local MechaHarness process (ProjectCodingConfig + openai_local) classifies oneshot vs todo list and does the token-heavy file edits under pre/item/post acceptance. Start yields `advice_requested` from soft point `external_guidance`; he answers `minimal` in a later call and the run completes. Complements `fangore_instruction_todo_plan`, `fangore_insp_graph_guidance_yield`, and `fangore_conversational_tool_loop`. He walks product steps (start, answer) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario.
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `guided_coding` (`GuidedCodingTemplate`) tiles `instruction_todo_plan` and `audited_infer_accept` under `plan_tile` / `audit_tile` with soft point `external_guidance` (`kind=guidance`). MCP `MECHA_MCP_HOST=project_coding` binds `ProjectCodingConfig` (workspace coding tools + `GeneratorLocalWork` / `ProjectCodingLocalWork` burst after guidance, including `request_guidance` restart for plan refinement). `DurableGraphGenerator._advance` invokes the injectable local-work hook when the guidance queue is empty.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `session.yaml`: environment + durable guided_coding + start/answer expects. Unit tests `tests/test_project_coding.py` and `tests/test_guided_coding_recipe.py` cover tools confinement, plan/audit tile topology, and offline local-work file write.
